title: TREATAS removes the values that the target column does not have

source.quote: If some of the values in the table contain values that do not correspond to a valid value in the column used to apply the data lineage change, then TREATAS removes the values from the input
source.supports: values with no match in the column are removed

source.quote: If a value returned in the table expression does not exist in the column, it is ignored
filters out any values that are not present in its respective output column

derivation: Product[Color] has Red, Blue, Green. Purple is not one of them and is removed; Red and Green stay.
